# cubepath_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

Manages a Kubernetes cluster on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) The location name (e.g., us-mia-1).
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.
- `plan` (String) The server plan for the default node pool.
- `project_id` (Number) The project ID to create the cluster in. Changing it moves the cluster and its workers in place.

### Optional

- `allocate_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether to allocate a public IPv4 address to cluster nodes. Defaults to true. Requires replacement if changed.
- `allocate_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether to allocate a public IPv6 address to cluster nodes. Defaults to true. Requires replacement if changed.
- `ha_control_plane` (Boolean) Enable high-availability control plane.
- `initial_node_count` (Number) Number of initial worker nodes in the default pool.
- `label` (String) Optional label for the cluster.
- `network_id` (Number) Existing network ID to use. If not set, a new network is created.
- `node_cidr` (String) Custom node CIDR.
- `pod_cidr` (String) Pod CIDR range.
- `protected` (Boolean) Deletion protection. A protected cluster cannot be destroyed until this is set to false. If omitted, the current setting is kept.
- `service_cidr` (String) Service CIDR range.
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version. Defaults to the latest available version.

### Read-Only

- `api_endpoint` (String) The API endpoint URL for the cluster.
- `created_at` (String) When the cluster was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the Kubernetes cluster.
- `status` (String) Current status of the cluster.
